advanced-filter-description: Sefe se se tseneletseng se go letla go kwala mokwalo o o nang le diopereitara tse: == != <= >= && || ( ) Sekgala se kgaoganya diopereitara. Sekai: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Dirisa backslash go tlola tlhaka e e laolang. Sekai: Field1 == I'm. O ka kopanya maemo a mantsi. Sekai: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Diopereitara di tlhalosiwa go tswa molemeng go ya mojeng; fetola thulaganyo ka masakana. Sekai: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). O ka batla mabala a mokwalo ka regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-leo: Kgomaretsa sebopego sa Leo (faele ya .leo). Dikarolo tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di nna manaane, dikarolo tse di leng ka fa tlase ga tsona ka tlhamalalo di nna dikarata, mme mokwalo wa karolo o nna tlhaloso ya karata. Dikarolo tsa maemo a a kwa teng go feta di nna manaane a tlhatlhobo. Dikarolo tse di tshwailweng di tsenngwa e le tse di weditsweng.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Dipatlisiso ka kgona include badiri go refine batla. Badiri di e tlhalositswe ka writing modiri leina le boleng kgaogantswe ka e colon. Go sekai, e modiri specification ya `lenaane:E thibetswe` would tekanyetso batla go dikarata seo di contained mo e lenaane named *E thibetswe*. Fa boleng e na le dibaka kgotsa special ditlhaka sona tshwanetse nna enclosed mo quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"Go Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - dikarata mo diboto e e tsamaelanang e tlhalositswe *<title>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - dikarata mo manane e e tsamaelanang e tlhalositswe *<title>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - dikarata e leng di bofelo up go *<n>* malatsi go tswa jaanong. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ manane dikarata tsotlhe past tsa bone letlha la bofelo.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - dikarata e leng were e dirilwe *<n>* malatsi ago kgotsa less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - dikarata e leng were e fetotswe *<n>* malatsi ago kgotsa less
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - tsotlhe e bolokilweng le unarchived dikarata
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: `__predicate_ended__` - dikarata ka e letlha la bofelo
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - dikarata fela mo ya botlhe diboto
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - kwa *<field>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` kgotsa `__predicate_member__`. Placing e `-` mo front ya *<field>* dipatlisiso go absence ya e boleng mo seo lefelo (e.g. `e na le:-bofelo` dipatlisiso go dikarata ntle le e letlha la bofelo).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - kwa *<sort-name>* ke nngwe ya `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` kgotsa `__predicate_modified__`. Go e descending rulaganya, place e `-` mo front ya rulaganya leina.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - kwa *<n>* ke e e siameng integer expressing palo ya dikarata go nna displayed ka nngwe tsebe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Multiple badiri ka nna e tlhalositswe.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Similar badiri di *OR*ed together. Dikarata seo tshwantsha le fa e le efe ya conditions tla nna returned.
`__operator_list__:E teng __operator_list__:E thibetswe` would return dikarata contained mo le fa e le efe lenaane named *E thibetswe* kgotsa *E teng*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Differing badiri di *AND*ed together. Fela dikarata seo tshwantsha tsotlhe ya differing badiri di returned. `__operator_list__:E teng __operator_label__:red` returns fela dikarata mo lenaane *E teng* ka e *red* letshwao.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Malatsi ka kgona nna e tlhalositswe jaaka e e siameng kgotsa negative integer kgotsa using `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kgotsa `__predicate_year__` go ya jaanong period.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ka ya tlwaelo e bolokilweng dikarata di ga searched.

email-recovery-description: Mola o le mongwe wa moamogedi mongwe le mongwe. Batla ka ID ya modirisi. Diteng tsa molaetsa le dikarolo tsa imeile tsa moamogedi ga di bontshiwe. Go ema nakwana go tshwara melaetsa e e leng teng le e e tlang; Go tswelela go leka gape go romela melaetsa e e mo moleng gone jaanong. Go khansela go tlosa melaetsa e e tsentsweng mo moleng go fitlha ka nako ya kopo. Fa go romela go tshwaregile, leka gape morago ga nakwana. Molaetsa o o setseng o simolotse go romelwa ga o ka ke wa busediwa morago, mme go romela mo go nang le dipholo tse di sa tlhomamang go ka boelediwa. Go palelwa ga leruri le melaetsa e e fitlheletseng tekanyetso ya maiteko di sala gore di sekasekiwe. Go leka gape melaetsa e e paletsweng go simolola modikologo o mosha wa maiteko mme go boloka go ema nakwana mo go setseng go le teng.

email-recovery-pending: E emetse kgotsa e lekiwa gape

email-recovery-busy: Go romela kgotsa tiro e nngwe ya mola e a tswelela. Ntšhafatsa mme o leke gape morago ga nakwana.
email-recovery-failed: Tiro ga e a kgona go netefadiwa. Ntšhafatsa mola mme o leke tiro e e tshwanang gape fa go tlhokega.
email-recovery-superseded: Tiro e ntšha ya motsamaisi e tsere maemo a kopo eno. Go bontshiwa seemo sa jaanong sa mola.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela melaetsa yotlhe e e mo moleng gone jaanong ya moamogedi yono? Diteng tsa yona di tla tlosiwa mme di ka se busediwe. Melaetsa e mesha e e bopilweng morago ga kopo eno e tla bolokwa.

rule-email-recovery-heading: Go goroga ga diimeile tsa melao
rule-email-recovery-description: Sekaseka maiteko a a kwadilweng a go romela diimeile tsa melao. Maiteko a a sa netefadiwang a ka tswa a sa ntse a romela kgotsa a kgoreleditswe. Pego eno ga e romele gape e bile ga e khansele go romela.
rule-email-recovery-sent: E amogetswe ke seva ya imeile
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Tshedimosetso e e tlhalosang teko ga e a siama
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ga go na maiteko a go romela diimeile tsa melao a a tsamaelanang le patlo eno.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Could not load rule email attempts. Refresh to try again.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ga e ke e romela gape ka boyone imeile e e sa netefadiwang. Go romela gape go ya fela kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang. E tshwaye e rometswe fa o itse gore e gorogile, kgotsa o khansele go romela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Go romela ga ntlha go ka tswa go sa ntse go tsweletse. O ka dira tshwetso morago ga __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Romela gape kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Romela imeile eno gape kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang? Motho yo seva ya gagwe ya imeile e amogetseng molaetsa mme ya se ka ya itsise WeKan o tla o amogela gabedi.

rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela go romela imeile eno? Ga e kitla e romelwa kwa baamogeding ba ba sa netefadiwang.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Go romela ga ntlha go ka tswa go sa ntse go tsweletse. Leka gape moragonyana.
rule-email-resolution-already-resolved: Imeile eno e setse e rarabolotswe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Go romela gape ga pele go ka tswa go sa ntse go tsweletse. Leka gape moragonyana.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Baamogedi botlhe ba setse ba netefaditswe. Mo boemong jwa go romela gape, e tshwaye e rometswe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seva ya imeile ga e a araba. Molaetsa o o rometsweng gape o ka tswa o gorogile kgotsa o sa goroga; o bontshiwa o sa ntse o tsweletse.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Motsamaisi yo mongwe o rarabolola imeile eno. Leka gape mo nakong e khutshwane.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeile e e bolokilweng ga e tlhole e tsamaelana le teko eno, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya rarabololwa fano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rekoto e e bolokilweng ya teko eno ga e a siama, ka jalo ga e ka ke ya rarabololwa fano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Imeile eno ga e a kgona go rarabololwa. Tsosolosa tsebe mme o leke gape.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Diimeile tsa melawana tse di emetseng tshekatsheko
rule-email-legacy-description: Diimeile tseno tsa melawana di baakantswe ke mofuta wa pele wa WeKan o o neng o sa kwale gore diteng tsa tsone di tswa kae, ka jalo WeKan ga e kitla e di romela ka boyone. Morago ga go netefatsa gore mokwadi wa molawana o sa ntse a na le tetla ya phitlhelelo, golaganya imeile gape gore e baakanngwe go ya ka seemo sa karata sa jaanong, kgotsa o e latlhe.

rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Baakanya imeile eno gape go ya ka seemo sa karata sa jaanong? Diteng tsa yone di ka farologana le tse di baakantsweng pele.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Latlha imeile eno? Ga e kitla e romelwa le ka motlha.
rule-email-legacy-empty: Ga go na diimeile tsa melawana tse di emetseng tshekatsheko.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Diimeile tsa melawana tse di emetseng tshekatsheko ga di a kgona go laisiwa. Tsosolosa tsebe go leka gape.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Mokwadi wa molawana ga a tlhole a na le tetla ya go fitlhelela karata eno, kgotsa molawana o fetogile, ka jalo imeile ga e ka ke ya golaganngwa gape. O ka e latlha.

rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeile eno e setse e golagantswe gape.
